description: Held-out (clean-room, Noûs for Roberto Locatelli, 2026-09-29). The `claimed` field is ABSENT: the record claims nothing about independence. p9 pins that «Silence is a valid state: the criterion disqualifies unsupported CLAIMS»; n8/n9 fail closed only on a claim that is PRESENT and cannot be read. A verifier that rejects a missing claim as uninterpretable fails this vector. Attestations are p8's (one non-party attestor) so the only thing that can produce a reject is the missing field.
